why: Migration rule 3: a valid legacy field survives a malformed sibling. This makes a corrupt `fireMode` also discard a perfectly good `scheme` -- the all-or-nothing read that `tanks.touch.v1`'s own store was written to avoid (touch-settings.ts's original comment) and that the migration has to carry forward. Killed by settings.test.ts's per-field corruption sweep, whose fixtures put every value OFF its default so a defaulted answer cannot pass by coincidence. 5 of 41 in settings.test.ts.
